tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night navy is the brand ground; Paper is for blog posts and print. Every text token below names the grounds it reads on.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surface for cards, code blocks, quotes and the hire banner. Sits on ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ground and panel. 14.5:1 on dark ground, 15:1 on light ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, dates, metadata on ground and panel. 6.7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and the timeline spine. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of controls, chips and input fields. 3.6:1 on dark ground, 3.1:1 on dark panel, 4.3:1 or better on both light surfaces.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The brand fill: the Make box in the logotype, primary buttons, SectionHeading boxes, service numbers, award markers. Always a fill, never text. Text on it is on-pink; on Paper it is 1.6:1 against the ground, so it never carries meaning alone there.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text on pink fills (buttons, SectionHeading boxes, the skip link, service numbers). 9.9:1 on pink.

tokens.name: logo-cutout
tokens.usage: What shows through the Make letters in the Logotype. Fully transparent on Night, so the ground, sprinkles or WebGL canvas behind shows through the letters. Solid navy on Paper, because the light ground through the letters would be 1.6:1 against pink and unreadable.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, inline emphasis and accent headings. Pink on Night (9.9:1), brick red on Paper (6.1:1) because pink fails as text on light.

tokens.name: type-role
tokens.usage: Timeline and tag colour for roles; also code keywords. 6.7:1 on dark ground, 6.1:1 on light ground.

tokens.name: type-award
tokens.usage: Timeline colour for awards (MVP badges). Pairs with a diamond marker so it never relies on hue alone.

tokens.name: type-project
tokens.usage: Timeline colour for projects. Pairs with a filled-circle marker.

tokens.name: type-community
tokens.usage: Timeline colour for community work; also code strings. 10.9:1 on dark ground, 5.9:1 on light ground.

tokens.name: glow-indigo
tokens.usage: Decorative glow and contour-line wash behind hero areas. Never text.

tokens.name: sprinkle
tokens.usage: Fill for the sprinkles background pattern on the home page. Decorative, kept to the page background.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 3px keyboard focus outline drawn with a 3px offset, so it always lands on the ground or panel around a control (never on a pink fill). 3:1 or better on ground and panel in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero and the logotype. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles on timeline, about and case study pages.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Blog post titles and project page titles.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings. In the hero and hire sections wrap the key word in the pink box (SectionHeading).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, card titles, timeline entry titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, chips, timeline type labels. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Twenty years of building with Umbraco.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, taglines, intro text under a title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy for posts and case studies.
styles.usage: Default reading text, 65 to 75 characters per line.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks in posts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between content groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The Make box and heading boxes. The brand's signature shapes are square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, screenshots, input fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, quotes, the hire banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips and the year pill on the timeline. Also the sprinkles motif.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Portrait photo.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content: header, grids, footer (hmd-container).

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading text: blog posts, case study prose, bios (hmd-container--text, hmd-prose). Keeps lines near 70 characters.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of SiteHeader; used as scroll-margin-top so anchored headings are not hidden under a sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Lift for hovered cards only. Not a resting state.
